desc: Implement the full-ternary reduction with two-pass (bottom-up down[] + top-down up[] rerooting) DP using top-3/top-4-with-source exclusion to compute branch values h(v,p) in O(N).

Verify equivalence of the reduction (attaching a leaf to the root of a full ternary tree yields exactly an alkane) and the candidate formula 2 + (top-3 neighbour branch values) for each vertex with degree ≥ 4.
Implement iterative BFS traversal (no recursion) and guard n < 5 / max-degree < 4 cases returning -1.
Test against all three samples (8, -1, 11) and edge cases; all public samples passed.
